description: GET ONLY the 'Avatar' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel. Avatar - the player's iDos Games account avatar in this app (one look per person for every app, edited on idosgames.com; drawn with @idosgames/characters AvatarActor from client.avatar). Enabled (default off: the app uses its own characters and the engine returns no looks), Styles (avatar styles the app draws; empty = every style; known: voxel-v1), BlockedSlots (slots never shown, their items taken off: hair, top, bottom, shoes, hands, waist, back, faceAcc, hat), HeightMin and HeightMax (0.9..1.1 on the standard's scale, 1 = standard; players outside are clamped).
name: get_avatar
title: Get Avatar settings
